title: Act: Add hover, label, click, contextual actions and keyboard navigation
summary: Extend SceneObject and add the interaction system and WorldScene bus wiring.
description: Implement interaction behavior in SceneObject, pure focus and action helpers in systems/interaction.ts, and emit objectHover/objectClick from WorldScene.
acceptance_criteria: Hover, pointerout and pointerdown on a SceneObject call onHover and onClick with the object id
Keyboard focus cycling and Enter activation call the same handlers through the built scene

steps.action: Export getContextActions(state: GameState, obj: ObjectDef): ActionDef[] filtering obj.actions with evaluateAll(state, a.conditions); export nextFocus(ids: string[], current: string|null, dir: 1|-1): string|null returning null for empty ids, the first id when current is null or unknown, and wrapping modulo ids.length otherwise.

Add optional 4th constructor arg handlers {onHover(id|null), onClick(id)}; create a label via ctx.addLabel(view.name, x, y-8) hidden and depth layerDepth('ui'); when view.actions.length>0 call handle.setInteractive(view.interactionBounds) and register pointerover -> setHover(true), pointerout -> setHover(false), pointerdown -> activate(); setHover toggles setTint(0xffe9a8)/clearTint, label visibility and calls onHover(id|null); activate calls onClick(id); destroy also destroys the label.
steps.expected: Hover and click behave per AC

steps.action: Add optional 5th param handlers and pass it to each SceneObject; add focusNext(dir) and activateFocused() to BuiltScene using nextFocus over interactive entity ids, calling setHover on the focused entity and activate on Enter.

Pass handlers emitting phaserToReact.emit('objectHover', {id}) and ('objectClick', {id}); register this.input.keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab to built.focusNext(1/-1) and ENTER to built.activateFocused(); remove key listeners on SHUTDOWN.
steps.expected: Bus events fire from pointer and keyboard
